turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
Please send your order number, the email address you used at checkout, and the full new delivery address, including the postal code and country.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.

Your order has already shipped, so I couldn’t change the delivery address. A colleague will take over and check whether the parcel can still be redirected. Please send the postal code and country for the new address.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified customer nora.blake@example.com asks not to deliver SC-3360 to the checkout address and wants Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu instead. Policy check denied standard change because already shipped. No change filed; please review post-shipment options. Postal code and country not provided.
